title: Answer: incoherence, inadequacy, or resonance without consciousness

statements.text: By its own method the scheme would count as failing if it were incoherent or if some item of experience could not be interpreted in its terms. Kim presses that no principle yet says how the mentality of a compound follows from its parts. For the resonance theory, resonance chains appearing equally in unconscious states would count against Conjecture 1.

sources.quote: Speculative Philosophy is the endeavour to frame a coherent, logical, necessary system of general ideas in terms of which every element of our experience can be interpreted.
we could, of course, be wrong about our axioms and posited mechanisms for the combination of consciousness!
